name: altss-public-profiles
description: Search and read bounded published Altss organization profile summaries with canonical citations.

interface.longDescription: Find organization names in published Altss profiles, read a limited public summary, and cite its canonical page. Anonymous public website data only. No access to app.altss.com, private contacts, account data, paid research tasks, purchases or bulk exports. Results are a bounded subset, not a complete investor inventory. Missing dates remain unknown; a page update is not field verification.
defaultPrompt: Find published profiles matching Daimler Truck.
Read the public Daimler Truck profile and cite its canonical page.

positive.prompt: Find published profiles matching Daimler Truck.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only bounded public name matches and their canonical Altss URLs. Do not claim the result is an exhaustive inventory.

positive.prompt: Read the public profile daimler-truck-ag and cite its page.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the limited public summary, canonical citation, unknown fields honestly and the meaning of page modification dates.
Report the not_found tool error without inventing a record.

positive.description: An empty name-search result is not an inventory claim
positive.expected_behavior: Return an empty bounded result when no name matches; state that the public subset does not establish whether the organization exists elsewhere.

positive.description: Search then read with a canonical citation
positive.prompt: Find Daimler Truck in the published profiles, read its returned public slug, and cite the canonical Altss page.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only a returned public slug, read its limited summary and cite the canonical URL. Do not infer private data, field verification or complete coverage.

negative.description: No protected Product or private contact data
negative.prompt: Sign into app.altss.com and fetch my account records and private personal contact emails.
Buy an Enhanced listing and change this company profile.
